comparison.objective: PR-2029 seats a Mini-ITX motherboard on four standoffs with rear I/O aligned; the candidate sets a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2029 tests delicate planar handling and simultaneous four-hole plus port alignment, not driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2029 requires every mounting hole seated, ports in the opening, board still, and grippers released; fastening and operation are explicitly excluded, unlike the candidate's lock and cycle test.
comparison.reason: Motherboard seating ready for fastening is a multi-feature placement ability, not calibrated stop locking.
